rule.definition: Use current oxygen when abs(full frozen ridge prediction minus current oxygen) <= threshold; otherwise use full frozen ridge prediction
rule.oldFlatHistoryFallback: Separate comparator, not combined with the new filter
rule.arithmetic: Finite binary64 inputs and direct <= comparison; no new rounding, boundary epsilon or clipping
rule.gridMeaning: Small engineering search fixed after inspecting the old data, before candidate scoring. Not a sensor accuracy, ecological limit or scientifically privileged set. The 0.05 cut was already inspected descriptively

split.selection: Accepted rows whose target timestamp is strictly before the boundary
split.laterCheck: Accepted rows whose earliest of twelve oxygen history timestamps is at or after the boundary
split.between: Exclude other rows from both parts and report their count; do not move the boundary to improve results
split.requiredInequality: Latest selection target < earliest later-check history timestamp
split.meaning: Internal temporal split within each already-inspected 28-day window. Not an unseen holdout, not globally chronological training across seasons, and not statistically independent hydrological blocks

selection.primaryMetric: Mean absolute error in mg/L on identical origins; equal weight for each of the four window MAEs
selection.eligibility: Strict positive macro-MAE gain over persistence beyond tolerance; no window MAE worse than persistence beyond tolerance; zero invalid or negative candidate predictions
selection.ranking: Smallest macro-MAE among eligible candidates; candidates within tolerance of the minimum are tied
selection.tieBreak: Among tied candidates choose fewest nonzero corrections on selection rows, then largest threshold
selection.noEligibleCandidate: Retain persistence; no promising threshold selected and no forced filter
selection.baselineTie: Persistence wins when candidate macro gain does not exceed tolerance
selection.precisionMeaning: Tolerance is arithmetic only; not statistical significance or practical environmental benefit

laterCheck.candidate: Only the one selected using the first parts; compare on identical later-check origins with all three existing methods
laterCheck.screen: Require positive equal-window macro-MAE gain over persistence beyond tolerance, no window MAE loss beyond tolerance and zero invalid or negative predictions
laterCheck.failure: Record development failure; do not select another threshold or expand the grid using these later-check outcomes
laterCheck.successMeaning: Promising only within already-inspected development data; not new validation or operational promotion

requiredBeforeAcquisition: one fixed candidate or explicit no-candidate outcome
nextUnseenTest.retrospectiveVersusLive: Finalized archives do not demonstrate historical as-of-origin availability; a prospective trial must preserve forecasts and available inputs before targets

mission: Verifiable environmental evidence supporting community and youth decision rights. This development plan does not alter operational Oracle, governance, quorum, treasury, token or spending
